notes.title: ver1.3 Implementation of Commentary Database
notes.content:
[h2]Implementation of commentary database[/h2]
A commentary database has been added to the title screen. This will be a strategy book containing explanations of unique terms, abilities and bosses, as well as behind-the-scenes development stories.
It can also be used as a hint when you get stuck.
